mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO show_subscribe (user_id, show_id, notify_before_minutes, notified_pre, notified_open, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{showId}, #{notifyBeforeMinutes}, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM show_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND show_id = #{showId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND show_id = #{showId}

SELECT ss.id, ss.user_id, ss.show_id, ss.notify_before_minutes, ss.notified_pre, ss.notified_open, ss.create_time, ss.update_time, s.id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name, s.poster_url AS s_poster_url, s.venue AS s_venue FROM show_subscribe ss JOIN `show` s ON s.id = ss.show_id WHERE ss.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ss.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ss.id AS subscribe_id, ss.user_id, ss.show_id, ss.notify_before_minutes, sh.name AS show_name, sess.id AS session_id, sess.name AS session_name, sess.start_time AS session_start_time, sess.open_sale_time AS open_sale_time FROM show_subscribe ss JOIN `show` sh ON sh.id = ss.show_id JOIN show_session sess ON sess.show_id = ss.show_id LEFT JOIN show_subscribe_session_notify n ON n.subscribe_id = ss.id AND n.session_id = sess.id WHERE sess.open_sale_time IS NOT NULL AND sess.open_sale_time > #{now} AND sess.open_sale_time <= DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 1440 MINUTE) AND sess.open_sale_time <= DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL ss.notify_before_minutes MINUTE) AND (n.notified_pre IS NULL OR n.notified_pre = 0) ORDER BY ss.id, sess.open_sale_time LIMIT 500

SELECT ss.id AS subscribe_id, ss.user_id, ss.show_id, ss.notify_before_minutes, sh.name AS show_name, sess.id AS session_id, sess.name AS session_name, sess.start_time AS session_start_time, sess.open_sale_time AS open_sale_time FROM show_subscribe ss JOIN `show` sh ON sh.id = ss.show_id JOIN show_session sess ON sess.show_id = ss.show_id LEFT JOIN show_subscribe_session_notify n ON n.subscribe_id = ss.id AND n.session_id = sess.id WHERE sess.open_sale_time IS NOT NULL AND sess.open_sale_time <= #{now} AND sess.open_sale_time > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1440 MINUTE) AND (n.notified_open IS NULL OR n.notified_open = 0) ORDER BY ss.id, sess.open_sale_time LIMIT 500
